parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Identify the relevant term: $\binom53(px^2)^2\left(\frac4p x\right)^3$, or $10(px^2)^2\left(\frac4p x\right)^3$. B1; may be in a list, allow with or without $x$; condone missing brackets only if recovered. Identify $\frac{640}{p}x^7$. B1; if in a list this term must now be identified; allow with or without $x$. Set their integer-$k$ $x^7$ coefficient equal to $1280$, e.g. $\frac{640}{p}x^7=1280x^7$. M1; condone disappearance of $x^7$ in subsequent work; must arise from the relevant binomial term. $p=\frac12$. A1 OE. Special case: B1 for selecting the term with one factor of $\frac4p x$, leading to $p=4$. Total: 4.
